name: claude-accessibility
description: Claude Code plugins that change how Claude works with you, by need: sore hands (carpal tunnel, RSI), overwhelm, and more.

plugins.name: carpal-tunnel
plugins.description: Claude for people whose hands hurt (carpal tunnel, RSI, arthritis): minimal typing and clicking, one-word answers, dictation read generously, voice first, no drags or finger-twisting shortcuts. Includes voice-setup.

plugins.name: i-get-overwhelmed
plugins.description: Claude for non-technical readers who get overwhelmed: calm first line, one thing at a time, plain words, click-by-click steps that say what you will see. Fork of ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT).
